facts.text: The Webster World Traveler Program provides airfare assistance to full-time undergraduate or graduate students participating in a Webster study abroad program.

sources.title: Study Abroad | Webster Leiden
sources.quote: The Webster World Traveler Program (WWTP) is an award that provides airfare assistance to full-time undergraduate or graduate students at Webster University to study abroad on a Webster study abroad program.
